title: Moment factor: (t+ε)^{1/(n−1)} μ(M_t)^{1/n} ≤ (∫_{M_0}(h+ε)^{n/(n−1)} dμ)^{1/n}
statement: Let n ≥ 2 and ℓ ∈ ℕ, and let μ be a measure on E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Borel σ-algebra) that is finite on compact sets. Let h: E → ℝ be continuous, nonnegative and compactly supported, and let ε > 0 and t ≥ 0. Put p := n/(n − 1) and M_s := {x : h(x) > s}, and write μ(M_t) for the real measure μ.real(M_t). Then (t + ε)^{1/(n−1)} · μ(M_t)^{1/n} ≤ (∫_{M_0} (h + ε)^p dμ)^{1/n}. All powers are real powers (Real.rpow) of nonnegative bases, and ∫_{M_0} is the Bochner set integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ε t : ℝ), 2 ≤ n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → (∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) → 0 < ε → 0 ≤ t → (t + ε) ^ ((n : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ * (μ.real {x | t < h x}) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (∫ x in {x | 0 < h x}, (h x + ε) ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1)) ∂μ) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹
